_about: Book canon story data (docs/SAGA_MASTER_PLAN.md). scenes: play once on entering a section; shifts: objectives inserted into existing quests (older saves move their step on); inserted: new main quests (older saves past them count them as done). Bump version when adding shifts or inserted quests.

lines: Behind a giant mushroom, a Helix grunt kneels beside a little cage.
He flips the latch. A tiny glowing sporeling hops out and bounces away into the mist.
He looks up and sees you watching... then puts a finger to his lips.
Helix Grunt: ...You didn't see that, and I didn't see you. Name's Strand.
General Ostrander: Halt. This crater has been under military guard for twenty years.
General Ostrander: I don't care how many Shards you carry. No children go past this camp.
Tamsin: General! They're with me.
Tamsin: I've mapped every inch of this crater, and I'll be at their side the whole way down. You have my word.
General Ostrander: ...Fine. But if anything happens, Tamsin, it's on you.
Tamsin: (to you) Told you I'd turn up. Come on. Stay close.
The valley is full of cracked, glowing seedpod shells. Zib zips straight past all of them...
...and stops at one small shell, half-buried in the rock.
Zib lands inside it and sits very still for a long, quiet minute. Its lights go soft and pink.
This was Zib's pod. The last one Liss launched.
Admin Vex: Pell! The little saucer. Net it. NOW.
Pell raises the net gun. His hands are shaking.
Pell: Helix Directive... Field Division... (He looks at Zib.) ...No.
Pell throws the net gun over the rim. It tumbles down into the crater's light.
Admin Vex: You'll regret that! (She storms off toward the engine.)
A hooded figure has followed you through the Vortex. It's Saga, the silent Quorum master.
Saga lowers the hood. Underneath is a face like clear crystal, flickering at the edges.
Saga: I am a Ystran echo. I came in the Mother Pod and lived twenty years in a borrowed human shape, guarding the Vortex secret.
Saga: The one who launched your little scout... Liss... is my sister.
Zib flashes every color at once. So that was the word Saga whispered at the Summit.
Tamsin finds a ruined room covered in star charts: the Ystran explorers' map room.
On the wall is a symbol shaped exactly like the question mark on her vest.
Saga: That word means "the place we haven't found yet."
Tamsin sits down on the floor and laughs until she cries.
Tamsin: Forty years. Forty years I've been looking for this. I think I'll stay a while.
The forest is gray and silent here. Small shadow creatures creep out of the dead trees and swarm toward you.
Your team braces for a fight... then you see it. They aren't attacking.
They're reaching for your light. They're begging.
A pair of legs sticks out from under a scrap cart. A kid rolls out, oversized welding goggles pushed up on his forehead.
Kit Briggs: Hey! You're the one Dad's been talking about. I'm Kit. Kit Briggs. Hank's kid.
Your bag wriggles. The {kit} pokes its head out... and leaps straight into Kit's arms.
Kit: Whoa! Hi! Where did YOU come from?
The {kit} snuggles in and won't let go. It has chosen Kit.
Kit: It... picked me? Nobody ever picks me first.
Kit: Okay. I'm coming with you. Somebody has to fix whatever you two break.
A pair of legs sticks out from under a scrap cart. A kid rolls out, oversized welding goggles pushed up on his forehead.
Kit Briggs: Hey! You're the one Dad's been talking about. I'm Kit. Kit Briggs. Hank's kid.
A little {kit} peeks out from behind Kit's tool belt.
Kit: Found this one curled up in a scrap pod. It picked me. Nobody ever picks me first!
Kit: I'm coming with you. Somebody has to fix whatever you break.
In the snow, a prickly little Iceburr is stuck, one leg frozen into the ice.
Kit kneels down, pulls a tiny heater coil off his tool belt, and gently melts it free.
The Iceburr shakes itself off... and hops onto Kit's shoulder. Kit: Ow. Spiky. Hi, friend.
A Helix gravity trap snaps on. Everyone is pinned flat to the glowing rock.
Kit: Iceburr, freeze the coils! Now!
Iceburr frosts the trap's coils until they crack. The pull lets go.
Kit: Got it! Keep moving, everybody.
A cold white sign hangs over the cage rows: PROJECT UNITY. ONE OF EVERY SPECIES.
Every cage has a label, a number and a species name, like a museum.
